text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(You never look down, no matter what happens.
Your back always shines so brightly—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is the true power of the Kingggg!!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ......Not yet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you truly wish to learn from me, brace yourself and watch me until the very end.
Watch this King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Did you witness
King's graceful and brilliant running?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a first-rate Umamusume~!
Are you aiming to sweep the Spring-Autumn Sprint double this year too?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's a high note to end on, so why not step down now?
Stop rampaging around for yourself, do it for your juniors' sake.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —I am the only one who has the right to decide that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I shall now grant all of you the privilege of listening
to King speak. Listen closely and take it to heart!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is a world of competition. Today, I'm the one
who fulfilled her dream, and crushed someone else's.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I take pride in having run that race!
I have no regrets about being selfish whatsoever!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I'm proud of myself for making the choice that feels true to me!
No matter what anyone says, this is my path!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooh, King Halo!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, that's right.
It was her back that I yearned for.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(No matter what pain she bore,
she always looked so dazzling.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Unafraid, yet earnest.
That bravery of hers, marching forward true to herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King-san.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good work. This time, the victory is mine.
I have prevailed over you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. And so, um...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Even if it was against you, I do not regret my actions today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how others looked at me,
I take pride in having acted not selfishly,
...but true to myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So if the day comes where we compete again,
I'll crush you with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I will not hold back against anyone.
—That is simply what it means to show respect to those you challenge."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. When that time comes,
I'll be counting on you...!
choice_data_list: ...Do you know how to paint your "ideal" now?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course.
The answer is already... right here.

And a few days later, Kawakami Princess
came to me with a certain proposal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, King-san asked me, 'Can you hold your head high with pride?'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Is this an action I can take pride in?
Is this truly like me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I don't want to be selfish;
I want to charge ahead true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No matter how I am seen by anyone.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. About the Fan Appreciation Festival next month...
I'd really love to perform on this stage.
What Kawakami Princess showed me was a certain stage plan.

""Looking back on last year's Tiara route!
A joint talk show featuring radiant Umamusume!""

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who competed together last year...
and their fans will apparently be gathering as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to take the stage for such a reason
would be unbefitting of a princess.

Her gaze was resolute,
as if she had made up her mind about something.

Yet deep within her eyes, she was wavering.
Trembling slightly,
but rallying herself to grow stronger.
